light.description: Clean, readable Notion/Linear style. Solves contrast failures.
light.accent_rules: Lime (#CCFF00) fails WCAG on white. Reserve Lime for dark CTA bands, footers, or hover states on dark buttons. Use navy/ink (#0A0F1E) as the primary accent color on light surfaces.

futuristic.description: Refined matte graphite-ceramic aesthetic. Neutral grays, sophisticated, ZERO blue.

typography_overrides.reasoning: Tighter, tasteful type sizes prevent layout breakage and deliver a premium, controlled futuristic look.

futuristic.accent_rules: Use the Lime accent extremely sparingly (e.g., small glowing dot indicators or a single 1px active line) to maintain the graphite-ceramic mood.

classic.description: Base dark navy with signature lime and gold. (Sanity Pass)
classic.sanity_pass: Overall solid. Ensure Lime text on navy has sufficient font-weight (font-medium+) for legibility. Keep surface elevations distinct.

material.sanity_pass: Ensure drop shadows are colored with the brand hue (rgba(5,10,20, 0.4)) rather than pure black to avoid muddying the colors.

multi_sport_tactical_board.problem: Rainbow/childish look due to vivid sport-specific gradients.

guidelines.board_surface: Desaturate and unify. Use the theme's 'surface_elevated' consistently across ALL sports.
guidelines.pitch_lines: Use a subtle monochrome tint (e.g., 'text_secondary' at 20-30% opacity) for court lines.
guidelines.interactive_elements: Reserve vivid colors exclusively for player nodes, routes, and arrows using the brand Lime (#CCFF00) and Gold (#C9A84C).
guidelines.sport_differentiation: Differentiate sports using small muted icons or a 2px colored top-border, rather than flooding the entire card background.

testimonials.problem: Light theme renders dark-on-dark due to hardcoded background classes.
testimonials.solution: Remove hardcoded navy classes. Ensure cards inherit 'surface' or 'surface_elevated' variables natively so they adapt correctly when switching to Light theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create or update /app/frontend/src/index.css to implement the four CSS variable groups: .lt-theme[data-landing-theme='classic'], 'light', 'futuristic', 'material'.
Map Tailwind utility classes to these CSS variables to remove hardcoding (e.g. replacing hardcoded Tailwind colors with var(--surface)).
Refactor the testimonials carousel and pricing cards to use theme-aware variables instead of hardcoded dark classes that break the Light theme.
Implement the clamped typography variables explicitly in the 'futuristic' theme selector (Hero clamp to max 3rem).
Refactor the multi-sport tactical board to remove rainbow gradients. Apply a uniform theme surface with low-opacity pitch lines and accent-only interactive nodes.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, theme-toggles) has a 'data-testid' attribute.
Apply 'accent_ink' logic for the Light theme to avoid WCAG contrast failures with the Lime color.
